marking.criterion: Mechanism: ACS Request/Completion Redirect forces peer TLPs from a switch downstream port up to the root complex for IOMMU validation
Isolation purpose: stops a passed-through device in one VM from DMAing into another guest's device
Bare-metal cost: one-hop in-switch GPU-NIC P2P becomes a root-complex round trip (lower bandwidth, more variance, or broken P2P)

title: ACS Request Redirect and GPUDirect RDMA
